description: Creates an automation from one of PuffinMail’s ready-made recipes, with its own copies of the emails, switched OFF: the store owner edits the emails and turns it on in PuffinMail. Recipes: welcome (Welcome series: Two emails for new subscribers: a welcome straight away, then your favourites two days later.); postPurchase (Post-purchase thank you: Three days after each completed order, thank the customer and invite them back.); reviewRequest (Review request after shipping: A week after each order ships, ask the customer how they’re finding it and invite a review (skipped if the order was refunded meanwhile).); winBack (Win-back: Customers who haven’t ordered for 90 days get a reminder, and a second one a week later if they still haven’t.); browseAbandonment (Browse abandonment: Someone looked at a product on your website but didn’t buy: two hours later, remind them of it (needs the storefront script).); sunset (Sunset unengaged subscribers: Subscribers who’ve had 5 or more emails in 90 days without opening, clicking or ordering are asked if they still want to hear from you. If they don’t respond within a week, they’re unsubscribed, which keeps your list healthy.).
name: create_automation_draft
title: Draft an automation
